value: It moves! Soggy thing. So soggy.
Soggy one, can you hear? Hear me.
I tell you your friends ran off. The bear ate one. But the other left.
He took your stuff. He went towards the festering man.
Soggy one, I’m near grown. But my sisters are out there. The festering man knows. Find him.
Another! The sea spat you out too, huh?
Your language is foreign to me. Do you speak the common tongue?
Aye. My flesh was unwelcome even in her hungry gullet, thanks be.
[narrate]He shakes his head and points down the hill at a monument along the shore.[/narrate]
[narrate]Next, he holds up three fingers, points to the goblins in the forest, and then points to his cookpot.[/narrate]
[narrate]Finally, he points to the tent and bows his head.[/narrate]
I’m afraid my cookpot is also empty. But if you find 3 cuts of goblin flesh you’ll feed us both!
And I am always willing to trade if you have brought anything of value.
Welcome to my most unpleasant home.
